method: Each venue measures trading volume in its forecast window. Contracts are split at their own venue’s median for the selected event type and horizon, then combined across venues.
cumulativeMethod: Each venue sums recorded trading volume through the forecast cutoff. Contracts are split at their own venue’s median for the selected event type and horizon, then combined across venues.
periodMethod: Calendar periods follow the source venue’s recorded forecast date. Multiple exchanges can list contracts on the same event.
